The post is titled "State-wise Most Exported Commodities in FY20" and is accompanied by a map of India with various commodities labeled on each state. Map of India: The map is divided into states, each representing a different commodity exported from that state. The states are color-coded based on the value of exports, with darker shades indicating higher values and lighter shades indicating lower values.
